headline: OLIX seeks AMS verification ownership for high-speed I/O in an AI accelerator
fact: OLIX posted a Senior Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role to own verification of high-speed I/O receive and transmit chains in its AI accelerator, including CDRs, phase interpolators, clock generation, equalization, samplers, slicers, deserializers, and digital control loops. The role defines fidelity tiers across RNM, Verilog-AMS, and transistor co-simulation, owns self-checking testbenches, coverage and sign-off, builds regression automation, and correlates models with silicon. This is evidence of a public hiring mandate, not proof of completed deployment.

sources.title: OLIX Careers: AMS Engineer
sources.summary: The official Ashby posting describes ownership of high-speed-I/O AMS verification, RNM/VAMS/transistor fidelity choices, self-checking environments, coverage, regressions, sign-off, and silicon correlation; no stable absolute posting date is exposed, so the Event uses year precision.
